subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 84 (WAM-26). MT-INFO (multi-information) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: RT-DY (reality dynamics) and MT-DEVF (multiple diversification). From MT-DEVF: INDIV-DY (individual dynamics). From INDIV-DY: OP-SPD (option spread). From OP-SPD: AF-NT (affinity nature) and PART (participation).
